description: TikTok Intelligence ET: list Seller API.

categoryL2Id.description: Store secondary category ID. Maximum length 1000

categoryL3Id.description: The third-level category ID of the store. Maximum length 1000

maxFirstCrawlDt.description: Estimated shelf time filter (maximum value), yyyyMMdd format

maxTotalSaleGmv30dAmt.description: GMV filtering in the past 30 days (maximum value)

minFirstCrawlDt.description: Estimated shelf time filter (minimum value), yyyyMMdd format (for example, 20240101 represents 2024-01-01)

minTotalSaleGmv30dAmt.description: GMV screening in the past 30 days (minimum value)

pageSize.description: Number of items per page. **must be a multiple of 10, the maximum is 100**; the upper limit of a single page in the official interface is 10, internally it is 10 after multiple pulls per page and then merged

region.description: area. Optional values: US (United States), ID (Indonesia), TH (Thailand), PH (Philippines), MY (Malaysia), VN (Vietnam), GB (UK), MX (Mexico), SG (Singapore), SA (Saudi Arabia), BR (Brazil), ES (Spain), JP (Japan), DE (Germany), IT (Italy), FR (France)

salesTrendFlag.description: Sales trend in the past 7 days: 0=stable, 1=increasing, 2=declining

sellerSortField.description: Sorting fields: 1=total sales (total_sale_cnt), 2=total sales (total_sale_gmv_amt), 3=average price of product SKU in the store (spu_avg_price)
